gloss: to confess; to admit; to come clean

definitions.gloss: to confess; to admit; to come clean
definitions.explanation: To truthfully reveal something one has been hiding, especially a wrongdoing or secret. Often implies reluctance or pressure leading to the admission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{白状|はくじょう}した。
⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白状|はくじょう}した⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白状|はくじょう}した。
examples.english: After a long interrogation, the suspect finally confessed to the crime.

notes:
Specifically implies confessing something negative — a crime, lie, secret, or wrongdoing. The word carries a sense of finally giving in and telling the truth, often after concealment or under pressure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白状|はくじょう}する: to confess a crime
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白状|はくじょう}する: to confess honestly
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{白状|はくじょう}する: to confess everything
- {白状|はくじょう}させる: to make someone confess

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{告白|こくはく}する→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧: to confess — broader, includes confessing feelings (especially romantic) as well as secrets
- ⟦{自白|じはく}→自白：13969_jihaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confess (legal term) — specifically a criminal confession in a legal context
- ⟦{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける→打ち明ける：04230_uchiakeru⟧: to confide — softer, sharing a secret willingly rather than under pressure
